segments.name: Pet Health and Wellness
segments.description: Premium pet health and wellness products including foods, treats, and supplements for dogs and cats sold through e-commerce and retail channels.
segments.evidence: The Company's continuing operations consist of the pet health and wellness business formerly operated by Better Choice. This business is focused on providing high-quality pet products under the Halo brand, including foods, treats, toppers, dental products, chews, and supplements for dogs and cats.

revenueModel.text: Pet owners purchase premium pet food and wellness products through e-commerce platforms, brick-and-mortar retailers, and international distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: Better Choice's products are sold across multiple channels: e-commerce platforms such as Amazon and Chewy, select retail partners, and international distributors.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company discontinued its Canadian pharmacy and healthcare services business operated through SRx Canada.
changes.evidence: Effective during the year ended September 30, 2025, the Company made the strategic decision to discontinue the operations of its Canadian pharmacy and healthcare services business conducted through SRx Canada.

changes.text: In June 2024, the Company exited its direct-to-consumer channel through halopets.com and directed consumers to retail partners.
changes.evidence: The direct-to-consumer channel through halopets.com was exited in June 2024, and consumers are now directed to retail partners for online purchase.
